@@ Ambush
@description:
  This skill is the ability to make a very precise attack. To Ambush skill a
  character must approach his foe undetected able to strike before the foe
  can react. At this point, the character must declare whether he is striking
  to kill or to subdue. An is then made normally, and an Ambush static
  maneuver is (0% activity) and modified by position, target’s alertness
  other factors (e.g., position, lighting, etc.). If the Ambush static
  maneuver is successful, the character modify his result on the resulting
  critical strike roll (using normal Arms Law Critical Table if the intent
  was to kill, Subdual Critical Table if the intent was to subdue). This
  modification consists of being allowed to adjust the critical strike any
  number up to the Ambush skill rank (not bonus) attacker. This adjustment
  may be either up or down. Note use this bonus, the attacker must first get
  a normal critical result on an attack table. If he does, however, this
  ability increases the chance of a killing or incapacitating blow
  tremendously increases the chance of a result that takes instantly.
  Rolemaster Standard Rules 196

91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 1.0u | +5 | As you are nearly upon your target, something warns him. You may make a Moving Maneuver (modified by Quickness bonus +10) to close with your target and succeed in your maneuver before he can react. If you fail this MM, your maneuver will fail.
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +10 | Now you have him, Cato! Your maneuver works perfectly. Be gentle.
